properties.name: A typed constructor's required fields are required TO CREATE and optional TO REVISE — across all 17, because a rule with an exception list is a rule the next type quietly escapes
properties.rationale: Reported from dev_storyflow by two sessions from opposite sides: one hit the retype burden, one hit the corruption it caused — four mangled fields in a single sitting, twice while actively trying not to, every recovery coming from `revision.replaced[].prior`. Measured on reflow2's own design: median required content 2,041 B on a Decision, 1,979 on a Requirement; 20% of all nodes force retyping over 2 KB to change one other field, worst case 23,990 B. The all-at-once refusal also serves a separate report that one missing field per error costs one round trip per field.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Content fields on every `add_*` constructor become optional when the node already exists, resolved from the stored value. `RequiredFields` collects them and refuses naming EVERY missing one at once, rather than the first. 18 toolsnaps now require only `id`, and all 18 descriptions state the rule.
